mapper.sql: id, exam_name, paper_id, teacher_id, start_time, end_time, duration, class_id, status, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.exam_name, e.paper_id, e.teacher_id, e.start_time, e.end_time, e.duration, e.class_id, e.status, p.paper_name, ci.class_name FROM exam e LEFT JOIN paper p ON e.paper_id = p.id LEFT JOIN class_info ci ON e.class_id = ci.id WHERE e.id = #{id}

SELECT DISTINCT e.id, e.exam_name, e.paper_id, e.teacher_id, e.start_time, e.end_time, e.duration, e.class_id, e.status, e.create_time, e.update_time, e.deleted FROM exam e INNER JOIN class_info ci ON e.class_id = ci.id WHERE ci.department_id = #{departmentId} ORDER BY e.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exam (exam_name, paper_id, teacher_id, start_time, end_time, duration, class_id, status) VALUES (#{examName}, #{paperId}, #{teacherId}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{duration}, #{classId}, #{status})
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam WHERE status = 1
AND teacher_id = #{teacherId}
